```{r}
# dna methylation analysis project
# step-by-step pipeline for tasks 1 to 12

# clear the environment and load required packages
rm(list=ls())
library(minfi)
library(limma)
library(gplots)
library(qqman)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)

# set working directory to the project folder
baseDir <- "C:/Users/LENOVO/Desktop/admission university/DRD/project/R/project 2"
setwd(baseDir)

# create a results folder if it doesn't exist already
if (!dir.exists("results")) {
  dir.create("results")
}

# read the sample sheet
targets <- read.metharray.sheet(baseDir, pattern = "Samplesheet_report_2024.csv")


# --- task 1: load raw data with minfi and create RGset ---
RGset <- read.metharray.exp(targets = targets)


# --- task 2: create red and green dataframes ---
Red <- data.frame(getRed(RGset))
Green <- data.frame(getGreen(RGset))


# --- task 3: get fluorescences for our specific probe address ---
address_id <- "18756452"
red_val <- Red[rownames(Red) == address_id, ]
green_val <- Green[rownames(Green) == address_id, ]

# make a simple table for the report
task3_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(Red),
  Red_fluor = as.numeric(red_val),
  Green_fluor = as.numeric(green_val),
  Type = "Type II",        # checked from manifest
  Color = "Both (Type II)" # type II probes use both channels
)

write.csv(task3_table, "results/Task3_Table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print("task 3 table:")
print(task3_table)


# --- task 4: create the raw mset object ---
MSet.raw <- preprocessRaw(RGset)


# --- task 5: quality checks (qc plot, negative controls, detection p-values) ---
# plot qc
png("results/Task5_QCplot.png", width=800, height=800, res=150)
qc <- getQC(MSet.raw)
plotQC(qc)
dev.off()

# plot negative controls
png("results/Task5_NegativeControls.png", width=1200, height=600, res=150)
controlStripPlot(RGset, controls="NEGATIVE")
dev.off()

# calculate detection p-values and count failed probes (p > 0.01)
# --- QC NOTE: Detection P-value Threshold ---
# We use a strict threshold of p < 0.01 to rigorously identify and count low-quality probes for QC reporting.
# However, in accordance with minfi package requirements and the professor's guidelines, 
# we DO NOT physically remove these failed probes from the RGset at this stage. 
# Normalization algorithms like preprocessQuantile() require intact matrices and do not tolerate missing probes.
# Thus, this step is purely for QC evaluation, and the total probe count remains intact for downstream FDR/Bonferroni correction.

detP <- detectionP(RGset)
failed_positions <- colSums(detP > 0.01)

task5_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(detP),
  n_Failed_positions = failed_positions
)

write.csv(task5_table, "results/Task5_FailedPositions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print("task 5 table (failed positions):")
print(task5_table)


# --- task 6: raw beta and m values & plotting densities ---
beta_raw <- getBeta(MSet.raw)
M_raw <- getM(MSet.raw)

# separate samples into two groups based on the targets file
group1_cols <- targets$Group == "WT"  
group2_cols <- targets$Group == "MUT" 

# calculate row means for each group
beta_mean_group1 <- rowMeans(beta_raw[, group1_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
beta_mean_group2 <- rowMeans(beta_raw[, group2_cols], na.rm = TRUE)

M_mean_group1 <- rowMeans(M_raw[, group1_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
M_mean_group2 <- rowMeans(M_raw[, group2_cols], na.rm = TRUE)

png("results/Task6_MeanDensities.png", width=1200, height=600, res=150)
par(mfrow=c(1,2))

# beta means density plot
plot(density(beta_mean_group1[is.finite(beta_mean_group1)]), col="blue", main="density of mean beta values", xlab="beta", lwd=2)
lines(density(beta_mean_group2[is.finite(beta_mean_group2)]), col="red", lwd=2)
legend("topright", legend=c("WT", "MUT"), col=c("blue", "red"), lty=1, lwd=2)

# m means density plot
plot(density(M_mean_group1[is.finite(M_mean_group1)]), col="blue", main="density of mean m values", xlab="m value", lwd=2)
lines(density(M_mean_group2[is.finite(M_mean_group2)]), col="red", lwd=2)
legend("topright", legend=c("WT", "MUT"), col=c("blue", "red"), lty=1, lwd=2)
dev.off()


# --- task 7: quantile normalization and 6-panel plot ---
GMSet.norm <- preprocessQuantile(RGset)
beta_norm <- getBeta(GMSet.norm)

# find type I probes
probe_I <- getProbeInfo(RGset, type = "I")$Name
is_type_I <- rownames(beta_raw) %in% probe_I

# prepare stats for the 6 panels
mean_beta_raw_I <- rowMeans(beta_raw[is_type_I, ], na.rm=TRUE)
mean_beta_raw_II <- rowMeans(beta_raw[!is_type_I, ], na.rm=TRUE)
sd_beta_raw_I <- apply(beta_raw[is_type_I, ], 1, sd, na.rm=TRUE)
sd_beta_raw_II <- apply(beta_raw[!is_type_I, ], 1, sd, na.rm=TRUE)

mean_beta_norm_I <- rowMeans(beta_norm[is_type_I, ], na.rm=TRUE)
mean_beta_norm_II <- rowMeans(beta_norm[!is_type_I, ], na.rm=TRUE)
sd_beta_norm_I <- apply(beta_norm[is_type_I, ], 1, sd, na.rm=TRUE)
sd_beta_norm_II <- apply(beta_norm[!is_type_I, ], 1, sd, na.rm=TRUE)

# assign colors for the boxplot based on groups
box_colors <- ifelse(targets$Group == "WT", "dodgerblue", "firebrick")

png("results/Task7_6PanelPlot.png", width=1500, height=1000, res=150)
par(mfrow=c(2,3))

# raw data panels (top row)
plot(density(mean_beta_raw_I, na.rm=TRUE), col="blue", main="raw: mean beta by type", xlab="beta")
lines(density(mean_beta_raw_II, na.rm=TRUE), col="red")

plot(density(sd_beta_raw_I, na.rm=TRUE), col="blue", main="raw: sd beta by type", xlab="sd")
lines(density(sd_beta_raw_II, na.rm=TRUE), col="red")

boxplot(beta_raw, col=box_colors, main="raw: beta values boxplot", las=2, cex.axis=0.7)

# normalized data panels (bottom row)
plot(density(mean_beta_norm_I, na.rm=TRUE), col="blue", main="norm: mean beta by type", xlab="beta")
lines(density(mean_beta_norm_II, na.rm=TRUE), col="red")

plot(density(sd_beta_norm_I, na.rm=TRUE), col="blue", main="norm: sd beta by type", xlab="sd")
lines(density(sd_beta_norm_II, na.rm=TRUE), col="red")

boxplot(beta_norm, col=box_colors, main="norm: beta values boxplot", las=2, cex.axis=0.7)
dev.off()


# --- task 8: pca on the normalized beta values (group, sex, batch) ---
# calculate pca once
pca <- prcomp(t(na.omit(beta_norm)), scale. = TRUE)
pca_vars <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

# 1. pca colored by group
group_factor <- as.factor(targets$Group)
group_colors <- ifelse(targets$Group == "WT", "dodgerblue", "firebrick")

png("results/Task8_PCA_Group.png", width=1000, height=800, res=150)
plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2], col=group_colors, pch=16, cex=1.5,
     xlab=paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_vars[1],1), "%)"),
     ylab=paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_vars[2],1), "%)"),
     main="pca of normalized beta values (by group)")
legend("topright", legend=levels(group_factor), fill=c("dodgerblue", "firebrick"))
dev.off()

# 2. pca colored by sex
sex_factor <- as.factor(targets$Sex)
sex_palette <- c("mediumseagreen", "mediumorchid") # custom colors for sex
sex_colors <- sex_palette[as.numeric(sex_factor)]

png("results/Task8_PCA_Sex.png", width=1000, height=800, res=150)
plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2], col=sex_colors, pch=16, cex=1.5,
     xlab=paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_vars[1],1), "%)"),
     ylab=paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_vars[2],1), "%)"),
     main="pca of normalized beta values (by sex)")
legend("topright", legend=levels(sex_factor), fill=sex_palette)
dev.off()

# 3. pca colored by batch (using Slide)
batch_factor <- as.factor(targets$Slide)
batch_palette <- rainbow(length(levels(batch_factor)))
batch_colors <- batch_palette[as.numeric(batch_factor)]

png("results/Task8_PCA_Batch.png", width=1000, height=800, res=150)
plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2], col=batch_colors, pch=16, cex=1.5,
     xlab=paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_vars[1],1), "%)"),
     ylab=paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_vars[2],1), "%)"),
     main="pca of normalized beta values (by batch / Slide)")
legend("topright", legend=levels(batch_factor), fill=batch_palette, cex=0.8)
dev.off()


# --- task 9: finding differentially methylated probes using t-test ---
# convert beta to m-values for statistics
m_values_norm <- log2(beta_norm / (1 - beta_norm))
design <- model.matrix(~ targets$Group)

fit <- lmFit(m_values_norm, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# get the t-test results
dmp_results <- topTable(fit, coef=2, number=Inf, sort.by="P")


# --- task 10: multiple testing correction ---
count_nominal <- sum(dmp_results$P.Value < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)
count_bonferroni <- sum(p.adjust(dmp_results$P.Value, method="bonferroni") < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)
count_bh <- sum(dmp_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)

task10_table <- data.frame(
  Correction = c("nominal (p < 0.05)", "bonferroni", "bh / fdr"),
  Significant_Probes = c(count_nominal, count_bonferroni, count_bh)
)

print("task 10 results:")
print(task10_table)


# --- task 11: volcano and manhattan plots ---
# volcano plot (using nice colors: tomato for significant, steelblue for non-significant)
png("results/Task11_VolcanoPlot.png", width=900, height=800, res=150)
volcano_cols <- ifelse(dmp_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(dmp_results$logFC) > 0.5, "tomato", "steelblue")
plot(dmp_results$logFC, -log10(dmp_results$P.Value), pch=16, cex=0.5, col=volcano_cols,
     xlab="logFC", ylab="-log10(p-value)", main="volcano plot of dmps")
abline(h=-log10(0.05), col="darkred", lty=2)
dev.off()

# formatting data for manhattan plot
ann <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
annotated_dmps <- merge(dmp_results, ann[, c("chr", "pos")], by="row.names")

man_data <- data.frame(
  SNP = annotated_dmps$Row.names,
  CHR = as.numeric(gsub("chr", "", annotated_dmps$chr)),
  BP = annotated_dmps$pos,
  P = annotated_dmps$P.Value
)
man_data <- na.omit(man_data)

# manhattan plot (using highly contrasting colors: dodgerblue4 and darkorange)
png("results/Task11_ManhattanPlot.png", width=1200, height=600, res=150)
qqman::manhattan(man_data, main="manhattan plot", suggestiveline=-log10(0.05), genomewideline=FALSE, col=c("dodgerblue4", "darkorange"))
dev.off()


## --- task 12: heatmap of the top 100 significant probes ---
top100_probes <- rownames(dmp_results)[1:100]
top100_matrix <- beta_norm[top100_probes, ]

# use sample names for the columns (Corrected from Sample_Name to Sample)
colnames(top100_matrix) <- targets$Sample

# assign colors for the boxplot/heatmap based on groups (in case it wasn't run right before)
box_colors <- ifelse(targets$Group == "WT", "dodgerblue", "firebrick")

png("results/Task12_Heatmap_Top100.png", width=1000, height=1000, res=150)
heatmap.2(top100_matrix, 
          main="top 100 dmps heatmap",
          trace="none", 
          col=bluered(75),
          scale="row", 
          ColSideColors=box_colors,
          labRow=FALSE, # don't show probe IDs because 100 is too crowded
          cexCol=1.2,   # make sample names a bit larger
          mar=c(12,4))  # increase bottom margin so long sample names fit perfectly
dev.off()

print("Heatmap successfully generated !")
print("pipeline finished :)")


```
